html:
SMTO-SKL-0185 — GitHub's answer was too large to read at once

GUID: 88322955-1a69-5a9d-b11d-0beb382b96c0
Slug: github-response-too-large
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: github

What happened

  • GitHub sent back more information than SMTO can read in one go, so SMTO stopped reading. Nothing on GitHub was changed by this read.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask the Agent to fetch fewer items at once, for example the 10 most recent, or to go page by page. Smaller lists keep GitHub's answer under the size SMTO can read.
  2. Narrow the request, for example only open issues, one branch, or one folder. Filtering cuts down how much GitHub sends back.
  3. If you need a large file, ask the Agent to download it as a file instead of showing it in the chat. Downloads are saved as files and are not held to the same size limit as a chat answer.

What success looks like

  • The Agent shows the results you asked for.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO, with a note of what you were trying to see.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A GitHub API JSON response exceeded the 2 MiB inline limit while streaming, so SMTO stopped reading it and returned no result.

What this means

  • Inline JSON response streaming exceeds the two MiB limit. This diagnostic adds no GitHub access. Inspect the original receipt and request stage before repeating work; preserve exact account, host, repository and object identities.

Why this can happen

  • Inline JSON response streaming exceeds the two MiB limit.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect page/query scope and response size; mutations are converted to unknown outcome when this prevents acknowledgement.

How to fix it

  • Request a smaller page (lower limit, default 25, max 100) or narrower filters (state, branch, labels, path), or fetch large file contents with github.contents as_artifact=true or a download tool. Inline provider JSON is capped at 2 MiB and projections are further limited.
  • Use a smaller page or an artifact download. Inline provider JSON is limited to 2 MiB and model projections are further bounded.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect exact provider state and authority first.

How to verify the fix

  • A narrower read stays within the bound or uses a supported artifact route.

What not to do

  • Do not expose secrets or blindly replay uncertain mutations.

Technical notes

  • This diagnostic adds no GitHub access. Inspect the original receipt and request stage before repeating work; preserve exact account, host, repository and object identities.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
